caption: The drawing depicts a large, single bronze bell mounted on a metal frame. The bell is primarily gold and brown in color, with highlights that indicate reflective metallic surfaces. The frame holding the bell is arched and brown, with visible texture suggesting a rougher or aged metal. The bell rests securely between the arms of the frame, which are connected at the top by a central axis. A mechanical handle is attached on the left side of the frame. The clapper, colored dark brown to black, is visible hanging at the center inside the bell. At the top of the bell, there is a brass rectangular plaque with inscribed lines of text. The bell and its frame are mounted on a rectangular base, also rendered in shades of brown. The background of the drawing is plain, off-white, with no other objects or decorative elements. The artist's signature and the title "Little Bonanza" appear in small text at the lower right corner.
title: Bell (From a Locomotive)
